gist: In the mall meeting Rachel worries about the cost of the aquarium and especially the insurance, and Ron says the budget will be a problem; in the marketing meeting Rachel argues online advertising is much cheaper than TV, and Sarah says shipping to Japan would be far more expensive.
notes: Four spans across two meetings, and the same speaker (Rachel) raises cost in both — so retrieving 'Rachel on cost' is not sufficient; the question needs both meetings.
